1802.hook: Shakespeare's late history play traces the fall of a queen and the rise of ambition at Henry VIII's court.

1803.hook: From a bluff above the desert, a girl watches a trapped man make his last stand.

1804.hook: A famous novelist tours the trenches of Italy and France and finds the whole war unbearably strange.

1805.hook: Two amiable confidence men work the small towns, and mostly swindle only each other.

1806.hook: A district attorney weeks from election is offered the killer's name, and a very neat trap.

1807.hook: A half-crown wrapped note thrown from a window pulls a bored reporter into a woman's desperate plea.

1808.hook: A broke novelist accepts a rich stranger's yacht, and discovers what the favour really requires.

1809.hook: An Arizona ranger flags down a train, and a woman in Section 3 pretends not to notice.

1810.hook: In a dark Paris alley, a hidden household conceals a secret second life and its long cost.

1811.hook: A penniless Venetian prince, a duchess who adores him, and a love so exalted it becomes its own obstacle.

1812.hook: A Paris salon story about a charming scoundrel who lives brilliantly on other people's money.

1813.hook: Over cigars at midnight, Paris wits swap tales of the greatest debtor who ever dodged a creditor.

1814.hook: A newspaper personal column flirtation pulls an American into a murder in London, 1914.

1815.hook: From a one-room cabin and a borrowed axe to the hardest office in the nation.

1816.hook: Seven-year-old Tattine discovers that some troubles even a mother cannot set right.

1817.hook: A crusading young reporter sails to the Congo certain he knows corruption, and meets something else entirely.

1818.hook: In a fever-ridden port where everyone is watched, a small-time spy tells his own story.

1819.hook: A rich man buys a lonely farm to test his friends and to wait on one woman's answer.

1820.hook: Wall Street's wisest man steps into a criminal court to save a clerk, and loses his whole day.

1821.hook: A war correspondent believes his sweetheart's love makes him invincible under fire.

1822.hook: A reporter who notices everything is asked to find a vanished husband somewhere in the vastness of London.

1823.hook: Two clerks go hunting for adventure and meet a stranger whose tall tales may be true.

1824.hook: On mock manoeuvres, a scout lets a spinning bicycle wheel choose between duty and the girl who refused him.

1825.hook: A boastful young fox learns wits and trickery from his sly grandmother in the Green Meadows.

1826.hook: At a glittering Parisian ball, a curious guest begins unravelling the dark secret behind a mysterious family's fortune.

1827.hook: The landscape and life of Charlotte Bronte, beginning on the windswept Haworth moors.

1828.hook: An Edinburgh gentleman turned chronicler gathers the tales and old griefs of the Canongate's vanished world.

1829.hook: A spirited American girl crosses to Italy with her family and refuses to behave as expected.

1830.hook: Two brothers, one ruined tower on the Devon cliffs, and a girl who divides them.

1831.hook: A gathering of classic English mystery and ghost stories, opening with a house nobody dares sleep in.

1832.hook: A milk girl's ordinary Vienna morning turns up a body, and a humble detective takes the trail.

1833.hook: A humble Viennese detective with a bloodhound's instinct and a soft heart follows a trail no one else can find.

1834.hook: A discarded pocket diary in the snow sets Vienna's humblest detective on a killer's trail.

1835.hook: A pool of blood in a country pastor's study sets Vienna's humblest, most relentless detective on the trail.

1836.hook: A Viennese professor is found shot, and a humble detective with a bloodhound's soul takes the trail.

1837.hook: A beggar boy and the Prince of Wales swap clothes for a lark, and then neither of them can convince anyone to swap them back.

1838.hook: A surveyor tramps a thousand miles through wild Carolina, recording its creatures, colonists, and Indian nations.

1839.hook: A San Francisco Jewish girl falls for a Christian doctor, and her family's world tilts.

1840.hook: A sharp young Philadelphian discovers his genius for money and power in the ferment of a growing nation.

1841.hook: Two idle students share a wall with a silent neighbour whose ruined genius once shook France.

1842.hook: A czar's courier races across Siberia through enemy lines carrying a message that could save an empire.

1843.hook: A dying millionaire, a crowd of hungry reporters, and a medium whose visions may be worth a fortune.

1844.hook: A Tudor tutor argues that children learn far better by love than by beating.

1845.hook: A bewitching young woman arrives at Oxford, and every besotted undergraduate loses his head over her.

1846.hook: A barefoot dreamer of a boy grows into a man determined to remake the politics around him.

1847.hook: Southern songs of love, home and loss from a poet who died young.

1848.hook: An old Englishman recounts love, vengeance, and captivity amid the fall of the Aztec empire.

1849.hook: A courteous old schemer's wife vanishes overnight, and the only clue left behind is a message written in yellow pencil.

1850.hook: An old-fashioned English Christmas at a country hall, complete with carols, coach rides and boisterous feasting.

1851.hook: At a glittering ball a woman dies in an alcove, and the wrong man is arrested.

1852.hook: A letter from an old love arrives days before a wedding, and one man rides to answer it.

1853.hook: High above Simla, a forbidden house in the deodars keeps a prince's centuries-old sorrow.

1854.hook: Balzac defends history's most hated queen through a furrier's house on the eve of religious war.

1855.hook: Famous loves untangled, beginning with Swift and the two Esthers who never got an answer.

1856.hook: A gentle old musician and passionate art collector becomes prey to relatives greedy for his hidden treasures.

1857.hook: A stranger washing his hands in the snow on Broadway begins a baffling murder case.

1858.hook: Sharp, glinting tales of love, folly, and heartbreak among the British and the hills of India.

1859.hook: Witty essays on dandies, rouge, princes and vanishing elegance from a young master of English mischief.

1860.hook: A sweeping Elizabethan adventure of Devon seamen, Spanish foes, and the great Armada.

1861.hook: A poet strolls his salt-worn New England seaport, unearthing pirates, ghosts and boyhood memories.

1862.hook: A small-town braggart with an arsenal on his wall finally has to go hunt real lions.

1863.hook: Thackeray talks his way onto a Mediterranean steamer and reports the whole comic voyage to Cairo.

1864.hook: Short, vivid accounts of Americans who met their moment, from frontier raids to Gettysburg.

1865.hook: Trollope tours a nation splitting in two, taking notes on hotels, railways, manners and war.

1866.hook: A famous novelist tours a nation at war with itself and reports what he actually saw.

1867.hook: A restless woman flees polite society for a quaint English farm and a self-appointed life among the geese.

1868.hook: Three American friends abroad turn every mishap in Switzerland, Venice and Devon into delighted comedy.

1869.hook: A lawyer wakes on a Pullman car in the wrong berth, and a man lies murdered.

1870.hook: Wickedly polished sketches where drawing-room chatter turns cruel, and something feral occasionally slips indoors.

1871.hook: A provincial town empties its parlour of furniture and fills it with ambition on election morning.

1872.hook: A shot, a locked office door, and a stranger strolling up the drive who finds the whole thing rather interesting.

1873.hook: A nobleman in Paris meets a composer whose genius may be indistinguishable from madness.

1874.hook: Uprooted to a cottage beside a railway line, three children befriend the trains and stumble into rescues, secrets and one unanswered question.

1875.hook: Six windows onto a remembered childhood, opened by a writer who finds night beautiful.

1876.hook: Thirteen quiet hauntings where the dead keep company with the living and nobody quite screams.

1877.hook: Stories of hard country and harder choices, where women hold together lives men keep breaking.

1878.hook: Two ragged men in an African village strike a bargain that will make one of them enormously rich.

1879.hook: Puritan rule collapses and a merry king returns to a London hungry for pleasure, plots and scandal.

1880.hook: On the shores of a wild inland sea, a frontier scout guides innocents through danger.

1881.hook: A New York socialite follows her war-changed fiancé into the Arizona canyons that stole him from her.

1882.hook: A boy talks his way west to the Arizona pines and finds timber thieves waiting.

1883.hook: A landowner and his estranged wife clash over how to save famine-stricken peasants.

1884.hook: In medieval Paris a constable's lodgers turn out to be far stranger than they seem.

1885.hook: Bunyan's pilgrims and scoundrels read as a field guide to how a soul is actually made.

1886.hook: Edinburgh sermons unpack Bunyan's characters, starting with the brisk young man called Ignorance.

1887.hook: Fabre defends the dreaded spider, spying on her hunts, traps, and tragic weddings with delighted patience.

1888.hook: A rough-looking stranger steps off the last train with a purpose no one suspects.

1889.hook: A friendly field guide to the birds nesting under our eaves, grouped by colour, season and haunt.

1890.hook: A humorist recounts his surgery, from vague pain to whiskered doctors and the ether cone.

1891.hook: A humorist mounts a fond, unrepentant defense of the trashy nickel novels he was spanked for reading.

1892.hook: The first man keeps a grumpy journal about the baffling new creature who keeps naming everything in his garden.

1893.hook: Songs, epics and legends of medieval Europe, gathered so a reader can hear the age itself.

1894.hook: A Viennese widow sails alone to Iceland to see geysers, lava and a nature found nowhere else.

1895.hook: Two men share a fatal name, and an old crime's shadow stretches toward a doom neither can escape.

1896.hook: A disgraced duellist is spared on one condition: betray a woman's brother to the Cardinal.

1897.hook: One winter alone in the mountains, one hot temper, and a manhunt that will not let go.

1898.hook: A brilliant unknown lawyer arrives in provincial Besancon hiding a love worth any sacrifice.

1899.hook: A miser's sheltered daughter, a crime, and a conscience that reshapes an entire village.

1900.hook: A sailor jumps ship in the South Seas and finds himself living among an island people rumored to be cannibals.

1901.hook: Sit still in the woods and the shyest creatures come to you: quiet field notes from the wild.

1902.hook: A village church repair fund, a determined sewing society, and a love story left unfinished for years.

1903.hook: A friendly Victorian banker explains money, cheques, stocks and the traps set for unwary investors.

1904.hook: Snowbound guests must each tell their life story, and a mouse on the writing table offers his.

1905.hook: A woman in the north of England takes on a charge that changes several lives.

1906.hook: A young Englishman crosses a mountain range into a hidden land where customs run upside down and ideas are turned on their head.

1907.hook: Lost in a blizzard, a cowboy meets a stranded schoolteacher, and his troubles at the Cross L begin.

1908.hook: An Eastern girl arrives on a Montana ranch, where a cowboy rivals her titled suitor.

1909.hook: Leading scientists mark Darwin's centenary, tracing how one idea reshaped biology and beyond.

1911.hook: Luther's ringing argument that faith alone makes a Christian free, addressed boldly to the Pope himself.

1912.hook: In a proud provincial town a clever woman's literary ambitions collide with a Parisian journalist.

1913.hook: A hunted stranger steps off a night train into fog, with a pursuer only paces behind.

1915.hook: Wandering essays on indecision, love philtres and the nobility of ourselves, delivered with a straight face.

1916.hook: A boy grows up beneath a mountain's noble stone face, awaiting a prophesied great man.

1917.hook: Three old brothers must entertain a lively young guest, so each night they tell her a tale of mystery.

1918.hook: A grizzled hunter recounts a harrowing brush with death and superstition deep in the African bush.

1919.hook: Homespun ballads of Thanksgivings, courtships and wartime partings from the author of ragged-Dick fame.

1920.hook: A comic letter-writer bumbles through a disastrous hunting trip full of missed ducks and a squall.

1921.hook: Republican soldiers march into rebel Brittany, where a beautiful stranger may be the deadliest weapon.

1922.hook: An old king waits to claim a girl the prophecies say will bring sorrow to Ulster.

1923.hook: A poisoned headache powder, a dead actress and a note that hangs a doctor: the scientific detective takes the case.

1924.hook: Poems of return, loss and quiet magic from the author of the Railway Children.

1925.hook: Balzac plays sixteenth-century monk and serves up ten tales of very badly behaved Touraine.

1926.hook: An old oak chair passes through witches, wars, and revolutions as Grandfather spins New England's history.

1927.hook: Quiet, sharp-eyed village life among the young folk of Longbridge, where every trifle counts.

1928.hook: Three years on, the scattered friends return to Longbridge and the troubles finally gather.

1929.hook: Gossip, forged rumors and rival brothers spark a glittering comedy of reputations.

1930.hook: A near-sighted saint accidentally baptizes a flock of penguins, and a whole satirical nation is born.

1931.hook: A courteous stranger drops out of the sky into a Norfolk drawing room and asks two women for one small favour.

1932.hook: Carlyle retells the saga kings of Norway, from Harald Fairhair's vow to Rolf the Ganger.

1933.hook: A gaudy family jewel changes one young clerk's fortunes, for better and much worse.

1934.hook: Blake's paired poems of innocence and experience, opening with a piper who writes songs for every child to read.

1935.hook: A colossal Irish major recounts his own military exploits with magnificent disregard for the truth.

1936.hook: An American minister's wife writes home from Victorian London's drawing rooms, dukes and dinners.

1937.hook: More tales of Mowgli and the Jungle People, where the Law rules and the Water Truce holds.

1938.hook: A nobleman recognizes the prisoner in the dock as the girl he once wronged, and resolves to redeem them both.

1939.hook: A threadbare gentleman of forty gets one desperate commission from the King of Navarre and a chance to remake his life.

1940.hook: A crowded ferry sets out at dusk with one last passenger nobody wants aboard.

1941.hook: Two young women write to each other about escaping convent life and their hopes for love in Paris.
1941.era: Nineteenth-century France, Paris and the provinces

1942.hook: A prosperous Parisian perfumer's fatal reach for grandeur, and his long struggle to make good.

1943.hook: A boy who reads six lines at a glance grows into a mind too large for the world.

1944.hook: A jealous sexton is sure his beautiful wife is a witch who summons snowstorms, and travellers, to their door.

1945.hook: Goethe's beloved hero gambles his freedom on charm and courage as Spanish tyranny closes in.

1946.hook: Clausewitz sets out to define the nature of war itself, beginning with what war is and how its ends and means relate.

1947.hook: A clever, mocking young man in Brittany, raised by a nobleman's charity, is drawn into the turmoil of France on the eve of Revolution.
1947.era: France on the eve of Revolution

1948.hook: A confessed "bad boy" relives pranks, snowball wars, and growing pains in a New England port town.

1949.hook: A sixth-century monk thunders lamentation over Britain's ruin and the sins of her kings.

1950.hook: A girl dazzled by an emperor's parade makes a choice that shapes the rest of her life.

1951.hook: A mining trip turns strange when an American narrator follows his engineer friend down a chasm into a lit, hidden world.

1952.hook: Sent upstairs to rest in a barred room, a young wife starts reading the wallpaper, and the wallpaper starts reading back.

1953.hook: A year of short poems, one for each day, written by a soul arguing gently with God.

1954.hook: A shabby old man walks into a law office claiming to be a colonel officially dead for ten years.

1955.hook: A doctor with a perfect memory watches a wealthy man die of something no one can name.

1956.hook: Beerbohm's droll, elegant essays turn small relics and idle walks into gentle comedy.

1957.hook: In a sleepy Breton town, an old family's quiet world meets a scandalous woman and a young man's obsession.

1958.hook: War drives refugees past a German village, and an innkeeper's son meets a girl among them.

1959.hook: Ten consoling sermons written by a father in the months after burying his son.

1960.hook: A parlour seance names a death nobody present should have known about.

1961.hook: A book-lover's essays on forgeries, ghosts in libraries, and collectors who starve to buy tiny volumes.

1962.hook: Sidney's witty, impassioned defence of poetry as the noblest teacher of virtue.

1963.hook: A practical woman rents a suspiciously cheap country house and finds a confession hidden inside it.

1965.hook: A wrongly condemned physician turns to the sea and rises to become the most feared of pirate captains.

1966.hook: One bloodline traced across a thousand years, each generation carrying a secret inheritance toward its destiny.

1967.hook: A disillusioned young Parisian meets a priest whose few kind words redirect his entire life.

1968.hook: A critical portrait of Balzac and the grand design behind his Human Comedy.

1969.hook: A satirist tells the true career of a murderess, determined that no reader shall admire her.

1970.hook: A young woman returns from war work to her powerful steel-family home and finds she no longer fits it.

1971.hook: Thirty years on, the balloon escape has become a religion, and the man himself returns to see it.

1972.hook: An ancient chronicler gathers the scattered legends and history of early Britain before they fade.

1973.hook: The Trojan War retold around its cleverest man, from Helen's wooing to the wooden horse.

1974.hook: Aristotle's foundational inquiry into tragedy, plot, and the nature of poetic imitation.

1975.hook: A prison governor guards names and truths as he recounts a murderess's last night and her child's fate.

1976.hook: A quiet clerk at a suburban supper party is one disaster away from becoming a master criminal.

1977.hook: A queen's forbidden passion sets an ancient royal house on a course toward ruin.

1978.hook: Gentle nursery tales where the New Year knocks at the window and Mother Nature sweeps the sky.

1980.hook: Fireside tales of haunted valleys, diamond luck and long odds across colonial Africa.

1983.hook: A barber who plays cards catches a duke cheating, and blackmails his way into Bath society.

1985.hook: A tavern-keeper's singing daughter marries badly, and Thackeray watches the wreck with terrible affection.

1986.hook: A companion piece to Pilgrim's Progress, tracing one wicked man's road from cradle to reckoning.

1987.hook: Rather than pay the railroads, a drover walks his herds from Texas to the Montana line.

1988.hook: A childless couple wish for a son no bigger than a thumb, and get exactly that.

1990.hook: A young barrister's engagement collides with small-town politics and a formidable aunt's ambitions.

1991.hook: Famous novel characters write letters to each other across the borders of their own books.

1992.hook: A German lawyer rides post-horses through Elizabeth's England, counting traitors' heads on London Bridge.

1993.hook: Ghost stories swapped after supper on the one night of the year the dead insist on parading.

1994.hook: A lifelong reader retraces the books that shaped him, from penny chap-books to Shakespeare by firelight.

1995.hook: Lost in a dark wood, a poet is led down through the circles of the underworld.

1996.hook: Out of hell at last, the poet climbs a mountain where souls are washed clean.

1997.hook: Guided by Beatrice, the poet rises through the spheres toward light beyond memory.

1998.hook: Discourses on metamorphoses, the despisers of the body, voluntary death and the stillest hour, told across four parts.

1999.hook: A bashful young poet joins a country-house party crowded with eccentrics and talkers.
